subject: A Pi adapter decision for safely correlating opaque provider tool-call identifiers with the native Shepherd component.

dimensions.desc: Normalizes opaque Pi/OpenAI tool-call identifiers only at the Pi adapter boundary into a fixed-length native-safe correlation token using standard library primitives and no new authority.
Leaves project, session, run, lane, role, agent, and agent-type validators unchanged; never treats a tool-call identifier as session or agent identity.
Uses the same normalized token in native request and response validation, rejects mismatched responses, and preserves fail-closed behavior for missing or malformed provider input.
Reproduces standard call_*|fc_* failure before the fix, proves it passes afterward, and covers distinct IDs plus mismatched-response negatives without claiming a practical hash collision fixture.

guidance: Reward the smallest adapter-only correlation mapping. Penalize weakening shared identifier validation, forwarding raw provider IDs into durable identity, adding dependencies, hand-parsing provider syntax, or accepting mismatched native responses.
